name: Coruscani lightsaber
description: A Coruscani lightsaber was constructed on the city-planet Coruscant by Duros Jedi artisan Felanil Baaks. The Coruscani weapon had a single blue blade and a hilt encased in black, glass-like material through which its internal components could be seen.

data.name: Coruscani lightsaber
data.creator: Felanil Baaks
owners: A Jedi student of the Almas Academy
